description.value:
Trigger You take damage, and a creature is adjacent to you.

The color of your skin flickers wildly when you're hurt. Select one adjacent creature; that creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the result of its saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to Dazzling Surge for 1 hour.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks until the beginning of your next turn.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled] until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled for 2 rounds.
